sources.facts: Official 2026-09-10 changelog identifies deepseek-flash as V4.1-Flash. Legacy deepseek-v4-flash aliases now route to it. Do not inherit old endpoint identity or claim an immutable snapshot.

thinking enabled with high effort is supported; temperature has no effect in thinking mode. Reasoning and final content are separate. Proposed top_p is 1, fixed in advance. No tools or conversational carryover.

Native output maximum 393216. JSON object transport exists, not strict response-schema enforcement. Responses expose finish reason, usage, model and system fingerprint. Only natural stop plus unchanged local validator may produce a candidate measurement.
Official model supports 128k context; this is not proof that the project's old 4096-token GPU service supports current evidence length.

Published privacy policy covers API unless separate rules apply and describes input collection. No API zero-retention or no-training entitlement was verified for this account. Public deidentified study transcripts and generated replies would leave this host only after separate authorization.
